result.summary: The page is largely functional with no critical or major defects. The main observations are a somewhat unbalanced promotional banner, potentially ambiguous promo code typography, and low-contrast secondary text/navigation elements.

issues.description: The promo banner's text and button are crowded into the left side of the card, while the right half is largely empty space.
issues.suggestion: Balance the banner layout or reduce its height so the content fills the card more evenly.

issues.description: The delivery code shown in the promo banner uses ambiguous characters that could be misread (e.g., 'TALLINN3' with a zero/one-style mix).
issues.suggestion: Display the code in a monospace font and clarify characters that can be confused, such as using 'O' instead of '0' or adding a copy button.

issues.description: Several key controls rely on very low-contrast light gray text (search placeholder, delivery prices, and bottom navigation labels), which can be hard to read for users with low vision.
issues.suggestion: Darken secondary text and icon colors to meet WCAG contrast requirements.
